description: Kotolak, a were-lynx of Slavic legends, a hunched lynx-man standing on two legs, thick tawny fur with dark spots, a lynx head with long black ear tufts and a ruff of fur on its cheeks, long sharp claws on both hands, glowing yellow eyes, fangs bared, crouched and ready to pounce, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
